lines.text_source: YAH!!
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: POXA!!

lines.text_source: How's it going, soldier?
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: E aí, soldado?

lines.text_source: We're training to keep us in shape while we recover.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: A gente se treina pra se manter em forma enquanto se recupera.

lines.text_source: Your general is incredible. It's amazing how easily he can move that massive sword.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Nosso general é incrível! É tipo magia ele mexer aquela espada gigante!

lines.text_source: HAH!!
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: AÊ!!

lines.text_source: Learning to fence is much more exciting than studying magic.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Aprender esgrima é MUITO mais legal que estudar magia.

lines.text_source: Though it would be incredible to be able to use a sword...
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Mas seria show demais conseguir usar uma espada...

lines.text_source: I know... Why don't you do me a favour? I hear stories from adventurers all the time and they always seem to match up on one thing in particular.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Saca só... Pode me fazer um favorzão? Fico ouvindo histórias de aventureiros o tempo todo e sabe o que é? Todas batem em um lance bem específico.

lines.text_source: They often talk about a sword abandoned near the mines on the Tempes Plains.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Eles sempre falam de uma espada que sobrou perto da mina na Planície de Tempes.

lines.text_source: I've always wanted to go and see it for myself when cranky Jivan lets me outside Hafin.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Sempre quis ir lá e ver com meus próprios olhos quando aquele chato do Jivan me deixa sair de Hafin.
lines.risk_notes: referência a 'Jivan' como 'cranky' — personagem Jivan com voz formal-misterioso; check tone compatibilidade e manter characterização sem spoiler

lines.text_source: I think it'd be the perfect sword for me!
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Acho que seria a espada perfeita pra mim!

lines.text_source: I spose' that, if you bring it to me, I'd have to change my mission from finding it to taking it back, once I've learnt to use it.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Se você me trazer, aí muda minha missão de procurar pra trazer de volta depois que eu aprender a usar.

lines.text_source: What'dya say? Do you accept my quest?
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Topa? Você aceita minha missão?

lines.text_source: YAH!!
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: POXA!!

lines.text_source: How goes it, soldier? Come to tell me about your latest achievements?
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Fala, soldado! Veio contar das suas últimas aventuras incríveis?

lines.text_source: Well, I was just thinking about sending you on a new and exciting adventure myself.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Pois é, eu tava justo pensando em te mandar numa aventura nova e insana demais.

lines.text_source: Seeing our general train was fantastic! I want to be just as skillful with a sword as he is!
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Ver nosso general treinar foi maneiro demais! Quero dominar a espada igual ele!

lines.speaker: Balof
